subject.title: feat(linux): Quick Chat agent switcher, avatars, per-agent routing, and configurable shortcut

question: Should Linux Quick Chat adopt the proposed persistent shortcut controls and macOS-style multi-agent parity as the supported Linux companion contract?
rationale: The patch adds user-facing capability and durable settings beyond the merged minimal Quick Chat baseline; the protected maintainer label requires an explicit human decision on scope and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Accept parity scope after proof
options.body: Confirm the Linux parity direction and merge after a redacted live run shows a selected non-default agent receives a sent Quick Chat message.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Keep only the parts maintainers want to support now, such as agent selection without persistent shortcut customization.

options.title: Pause for a dedicated design decision
options.body: Defer the parity expansion until the Linux companion’s persistent-settings and shortcut UX direction is documented.

recommendation.title: Accept parity scope after proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the Linux parity direction and merge after a redacted live run shows a selected non-default agent receives a sent Quick Chat message.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor introduced the merged Linux Quick Chat baseline and authored the parity design under review.
